deviations: Exit filter scope: the fold tracks one open position per mint, so two strategies cannot hold concurrent positions on one mint. test_each_position_on_a_mint_is_filtered_by_its_own_ticket covers the reachable case: strategy A closes on a mint, then strategy B re-enters it under its own ticket, and B's ticket is not blocked by A's pending sell.

Exit filter also skips a graduation close for a strategy position with a pending sell. The plan text names only rule sells; a graduation close on the same position would otherwise close it while its pending sell is still open. Non-strategy positions are unchanged.

build_live_paper_root takes budget, limits, max_age_s and max_observations as required keyword arguments with no defaults. The staleness and observation bounds are deployment choices and are not pinned here.

The root's risk engine uses the default manual-ticket autonomy and the host kill-switch file under data_dir. The root has no event consumers; its EventBus dead-letter sink raises instead of dropping an event.
Plan 15-05 names a SUMMARY file. Not written, per the shared rule against writing .planning/**/SUMMARY files in this wave.
